verdict.rationale: Bulk operations, such as acting on many issues or items at once, are a fair question for a monitoring platform like Sentry, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a bulk-action capability. The nearest items, dashboard filters and duplication and an official CLI being documented, are adjacent features and do not show bulk operations across many items.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
